topic: TDM performance benchmark for a development
idea: Site-based TDM policies set a measurable goal by one of three metrics: automobile trips generated (driveway counts), non-auto mode use (mode split, most common: share driving alone), or parking space use; the benchmark is either a universal formula by land use and location or negotiated per site (trip reduction as percent below a baseline). Triggers: development size (e.g. more than 25 or 50 peak trips). Measured by counts, surveys, parking counts at 1-2 year intervals.
does: For an institution, test its simulated mode split and driveway trips against a goal (max drive-alone share, or percent trip reduction against a baseline run), and test levers: a parking charge or transit pass entered as cost terms in institution_mode_split, reporting the change in car trips and whether the goal is met.
inputs: institution id, goal metric and value, lever (parking cost, transit subsidy, headway)
outputs: drive-alone share, car trips a day, pass/fail, lever needed to meet goal
existing: partial: institution_mode_split (multinomial logit with cost), list_institutions
cite: Ch 4 Quantitative Goals, Table 6; Ch 5 Steps 4-6
notes: The report has no elasticities or formulas; only goal-setting structure. Lever effects must come from the logit already in ACMS.
